name: 公開前のストア保護状態と解除操作カード
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Shopify store-protection card as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact crop is 395x405 pixels (0.975:1). Preserve the compact near-square white card with its thin pale-gray outline and rounded upper corners. Do not add neighboring cards, a page title, or extra controls.

At the upper left, show the medium-weight dark heading 「オンラインストアのロックを解除」. Below it, use two lines of smaller gray text: 「公開準備が整うまで、ストアは」 and 「パスワードで保護されます。」. Preserve the large open white area between the description and the illustration.

In the lower-right half, closely preserve the supplied illustration: a large silver key ring near the upper-right, with a metallic key extending diagonally down-left. In front of the key is the same cheerful green shopping-bag/store mascot, with a rectangular green body, rounded upper corners, dark green handle/outline, expressive dark eyes and smiling mouth, small white-gloved arms, and green-and-white sneakers. Keep the mascot's pose, key angle, colors, outlined hand-drawn style, highlights, and relative scale from the source; do not invent a different character or replace the illustration with a generic lock icon.

At the bottom left, show a compact white rounded button with a fine gray outline and the label 「ストアのロックを解除」. Use small clean system sans-serif typography, restrained gray borders, generous white space, and the exact 395x405 composition. Use the supplied crop as the authority for original artwork, wording hierarchy, positions, and proportions.
reviewNotes: v001 closely preserves the key-and-green-mascot artwork and card hierarchy, with the source aspect within 0.1%. However, the Japanese Unlock store label expands the button to about 38% of card width beyond the source proportion. Retaining as needs-correction before the second allowed attempt with shorter localized copy.
